vfx_core_sizzle_wave.name: Sizzle Heat Wave & Burn Embers
vfx_core_sizzle_wave.summary: Sweeping heat distortion wave, rising cinnamon/kiln steam, Toasty ember rings, Five-Alarm Burn flame upgrades, and instant double burn-tick pop bursts.

vfx_core_drench_splash.name: Drench Splash, Mist & Droplet Spray
vfx_core_drench_splash.summary: Tintable liquid splash primitive supporting Windex blue mist, bubbly sourdough beige foam, iced cold brew, wine pour, 360-degree wet-dog shake spray, and nursery cool-mist clouds.

vfx_core_razzle_beam_arc.name: Razzle Voltage Arc, Beam & Glitter
vfx_core_razzle_beam_arc.summary: Covers voltage-tester sparks, copper banner links, 240V chain-lightning splashes, flashlight/camera LED beams, neon glitter ribbons, and Dazzled sparkle icons.

vfx_core_racket_rings.name: Racket Sonic Rings & Callout Waves
vfx_core_racket_rings.summary: Expanding acoustic rings for VIP pass flick reverberations, sugar-cube crunch, Rikers bark, 5-beat teacher clap, violin screech, dad-sneeze, raspberry, hot-mic feedback, and Broadway vocal belt.

vfx_core_detonation_pops.name: All 6 v11 Prime -> Detonation Bursts
vfx_core_detonation_pops.summary: Shared global combat payoff VFX for Steam Cloud! (blind mist), Panic Boil! (guard drop), Hydro-Slip! (25% push), Short Circuit! (40% splash), Shatter Glitz! (buff strip), and Sensory Overload! (-25% Atk).

vfx_core_composure_break.name: Composure Pip Shatter & Flustered Banner
vfx_core_composure_break.summary: Fires whenever a move shaves 1-4 Composure pips; escalates into a full dramatic shatter-ring and Flustered slowdown banner when pips hit 0.

vfx_core_heal_cleanse.name: Emerald Heal, Regen, Cleanse & Revive
vfx_core_heal_cleanse.summary: Handles single/party heals (5%-100%), overheal-to-Clean-Bill-Shield conversion glow, rising debuff-dissolve sparks, and vertical revive beams (25% Pick-Me-Up, 40% Waymo, 80% Moon).

vfx_core_shield_ward.name: Ally Shield, Carapace, Drywall & Ward Shell
vfx_core_shield_ward.summary: Unified defensive overlay supporting Velvet Stanchion, Pottery Wheel Clay -> Fired Glaze, Gypsum Drywall, Cozy Jacket Wrap, Golden Bread Crust, Mom-Arm Seatbelt Bar, and Plushie Self-Shield.

vfx_core_timeline_chevrons.name: Timeline Push, Pull, Swap & Pep/Ruckus Pop
vfx_core_timeline_chevrons.summary: Immediately communicates timeline manipulation (10%-35% pushback, 15%-30% turn pull, 25-tick swap, bonus mini-turn ring) plus +1/+2 Pep stars and +20%/+25% Family Ruckus surge arcs.

vfx_core_status_debuff_badges.name: Stat Buff/Debuff, Strip, Invert & Taunt Tether
vfx_core_status_debuff_badges.summary: Handles Eyes On Me spotlight, aggro tethers, buff-strip shatter orbs, buff-steal flight arcs, Fact-Check buff inversion flips, 4-Tab Mix markers, forced Razzle Pet Peeve badge, and permanent Def-crack fissures.

proj_arc_single.name: Lobbed Projectile Arc Engine
proj_arc_single.summary: Drives parabolic right-to-left projectile travel with spin, shadow projection, and impact trigger. Swaps sprite for wet clay, chili seeds, 1989 Mason jar, yellow penalty flag, buttered popcorn, and 80-lb toolbox.

proj_boomerang_return.name: Boomerang & Fishing-Line Pull Engine
proj_boomerang_return.summary: Handles out-and-back projectiles that physically bonk the enemy at t=0.5 and curve cleanly back to the caster's hand (soup dumpling, wrist-strap controller, tattered Lamby, and Boppy's pier fishing line + lure).

proj_ally_handoff_party.name: Ally Toss & Party Snack Distribution Engine
proj_ally_handoff_party.summary: Arcs tangible items directly from caster into one or all four ally slots (neon NeeDoh ball, frosted cinnamon roll, diaper-bag snacks, dairy-free snack pack, warm apple muffins from 12-cup tin, rental e-bike chirp).

proj_ground_hazard_mat.name: Persistent Ground Hazard & Lava Floor Engine
proj_ground_hazard_mat.summary: Renders perspective-matched floor overlays beneath enemy feet for multi-turn traps and floor-is-lava sequences: Wet-Floor soapy slick, Bedazzle-Gun hot-glue rhinestone mat, bubbling molten lava under floating sofa cushions, and Skateboard rolling debris.

setpiece_black_porsche_suv.name: Delta 360 Black Tarmac Porsche SUV
setpiece_black_porsche_suv.summary: Screeches right-to-left across the enemy half of the clearing with blinding LED high-beams and swirling jet-wash rings for Tom's Frequent Flier Capstone.

setpiece_delta_one_pod_doors.name: Delta One Privacy-Pod Sliding Doors
setpiece_delta_one_pod_doors.summary: Materializes and physically glides shut around adjacent allies during Suite Door Slide, clicking cabin lock lights on with redirect tethers back to Tom.

setpiece_giant_sky_controller.name: Giant Sky-Dropped Floor Controller (Konami Code)
setpiece_giant_sky_controller.summary: Drops from the sky beneath Tom's sneakers so he can hop across the oversized D-pad and B/A buttons reciting the Konami Code, then fires rainbow starbeams and retro meteors across all foes.

setpiece_3tier_sparkler_cake.name: Three-Tier Showstopper Cake Cart
setpiece_3tier_sparkler_cake.summary: Rolls onto the party side blazing with golden sparkler candles to heal, cleanse, and infuse all allies' next attacks with Sizzle embers.

setpiece_diamond_gold_dumpling.name: Colossal Sky-Steamer & Diamond-Gold Dumpling
setpiece_diamond_gold_dumpling.summary: Unlatches overhead to drop a house-sized Sparkling Diamond-Gold Soup Dumpling onto the chosen ally, bouncing softly with golden Pep bursts to grant a free skill.

setpiece_giant_easel_portrait.name: Giant Wooden Easel & Neon Portrait Reveal
setpiece_giant_easel_portrait.summary: Flips open beside Grace as velvet falls away, blasting neon watercolor waves and craft gems into the target enemy to force a temporary Razzle Pet Peeve.

setpiece_broadway_spotlights.name: Broadway Spotlights & Flashbulb Rig
setpiece_broadway_spotlights.summary: Dims the clearing slightly while sweeping three golden theatre spotlights onto Grace's soaring split-leap triple-twist dismount and popping flashbulbs at impact.

setpiece_sofa_cushion_fort.name: Sofa-Cushion Citadel & Twin-Lamby Lookouts
setpiece_sofa_cushion_fort.summary: Assembles a sturdy living-room pillow fort spanning all four party slots with both Lambies perched on top as lookouts blocking timeline pushback.

setpiece_blanket_kingdom_castle.name: Star-Lit Kingdom of Ten-Thousand Blankets
setpiece_blanket_kingdom_castle.summary: Rises behind the party bathed in warm twinkling string lights to deliver a 60% ally heal and full cleanse before rolling an AoE Sizzle warmth wave left.

setpiece_mega_whoopee_cushion.name: Trampoline-Sized Pink Whoopee Cushion
setpiece_mega_whoopee_cushion.summary: Slides smoothly under all enemies and detonates in an earth-shaking tuba-blasting PFFFFRT! shockwave that shatters active stances and drops enemy Attack.

setpiece_8seat_sunday_table.name: Full-House 8-Seat Sunday Dinner Table
setpiece_8seat_sunday_table.summary: Glides across the party side for 2 full rounds, bathing every teammate in candlelight so each ally turn opens with 15% heal, +1 Pep, and a random stat boost.

setpiece_rising_full_moon.name: Rising Full Moon & Moonlight Embrace
setpiece_rising_full_moon.summary: Lifts a radiant full moon above the clearing for Deedee's To the Moon & Back Capstone: 80% revive / 100% heal on target ally + warm AoE Sizzle shockwave (-2 Composure).

setpiece_50yr_dust_tsunami.name: Fifty-Year Sparkling Soapy Tsunami
setpiece_50yr_dust_tsunami.summary: Surges right-to-left across the entire enemy clearing, scrubbing away all enemy hazards, buffs, and stealth while leaving every foe gleaming and Drenched.

setpiece_rikers_iron_gates.name: Gleaming Brass-and-Iron Rikers Warden Gates
setpiece_rikers_iron_gates.summary: Thunders down vertically in front of all four party slots for 2 rounds (-40% AoE damage taken + Clobber melee thorns) as Boppy slams his brass keys.

setpiece_cattail_pier_leviathan.name: Cattail Pier Pilings, Swells & Breaching Catch (NO BOAT)
setpiece_cattail_pier_leviathan.summary: Strictly honors the NO-BOAT canon lock: anchors weathered Cattail Pier pilings and a shore folding chair on Boppy's edge while Long Island Sound swells surge on the left for both Trophy Striper Haul and the whale-sized Leviathan breach.

setpiece_sentient_ghost_pepper.name: Sentient Back-Garden Ghost Pepper
setpiece_sentient_ghost_pepper.summary: Floats forward off Boppy's open palm and unleashes a massive roaring cone of Sizzle fire that triggers 2 full burn ticks across all foes without consuming burns.

setpiece_leaning_grand_amphora.name: Leaning Museum-Sized Grand Terracotta Amphora
setpiece_leaning_grand_amphora.summary: Rises calmly between the formations to absorb 2 hits before shattering outward across every foe in razor-sharp glazed Clobber and Razzle shards (-2 Composure).

setpiece_waymo_and_la_metro.name: Autonomous Waymo SUV & LA Metro Express Train
setpiece_waymo_and_la_metro.summary: Two iconic car-free LA transit set-pieces for TNB Longboarder: the white Waymo SUV lidar-blinding foes while opening its door for a 40% revive, and the gleaming LA Metro train rushing alongside steep Baxter Street lines.

setpiece_eighth_dining_chair.name: Ornate Eighth Wooden Dining Chair
setpiece_eighth_dining_chair.summary: Slides cleanly beneath Nara so she can hop onto her own human seat on all four paws and bark her pie-crust decree (-1 Composure all foes, party mental cleanse, +20% pull).

setpiece_stadium_jumbotron.name: Stadium Jumbotron Instant Replay Screen
setpiece_stadium_jumbotron.summary: Drops above the meadow for Justin's Armchair Ref Capstone, visibly rewinding 50% of the last ally hit taken while slamming the offending monster with a -25% Def Racket penalty beam.

setpiece_michael_sprint_and_chopper.name: 6'4" Michael Toddler Sprint & LivNews Chopper
setpiece_michael_sprint_and_chopper.summary: Olivia's two signature large-scale set-pieces: 6'4" Michael sprinting across the field to startle foes (-25% bar) while sliding hot dinner to the party, and the LivNews chopper sweeping twin searchlights with a BREAKING NEWS ticker.

setpiece_gym_bleachers_and_ruckus_crest.name: Neon Gym Bleachers Pyro & 100% Family Ruckus Crest
setpiece_gym_bleachers_and_ruckus_crest.summary: Shared climactic arena overlays: neon championship gym bleachers and pyro for Olivia's Rope Champ Capstone, plus the 50% Double Team link flash and 100% Full Family Ruckus storybook crest.
